reviews.body: 🦸‍♂️ **Approved.** Verified on head eabca638: the fix sorts only the tool-call indexes actually seen, so ordering is deterministic and sparse indexes from proxies like point-p1/9router stay safe (no 0..len-1 walk, nil slot still skipped). The new test streams indexes 2,0,5 over 25 rounds and asserts first/third/fifth with no ParseError, so it guards both the order and the sparse case. Two files (+87/-5), CLEAN, go/web/release-versioning all SUCCESS. Non-blocking: only the providers package was tested locally, which is fine given the change is isolated to one function.
